title: Handling sensitive legal information: data protection tips for paralegals on Mac
metaTitle: Data protection for paralegals: handling sensitive legal information on Mac
description: Learn how to improve data protection when handling sensitive legal information on your Mac. Practical steps to reduce risk and manage case files securely.
intro: Handling sensitive legal information requires constant vigilance to protect client privacy and firm reputation. As a paralegal, you are often the first line of defense against accidental data exposure while juggling high-volume case files.
tldr: Human error is the leading cause of data breaches in law firms.
Use built-in macOS security features like FileVault and Firewall.
Standardize your workflow to avoid storing files in unapproved locations.
Always follow your firm's specific data handling and security policies.
Use dedicated tools for redaction and secure file management.

blocks.text: The reality of handling sensitive legal information

You manage hundreds of documents every week. Between case management systems and email attachments, it is easy to lose track of where sensitive data lives. This creates a high-pressure environment where minor mistakes lead to major consequences. A misdirected email or an unencrypted file can compromise a client case instantly.

items: Fragmented workflows where files are saved in multiple, unverified locations.
Shadow data that exists outside of authorized firm servers or cloud storage.
Fatigue from managing over 100 active cases simultaneously.
Lack of standardized procedures for secure file sharing and naming.

blocks.text: You do not need expensive software to start improving your security. Start by locking down your Mac's core settings. Enable FileVault to encrypt your entire startup disk. Go to System Settings > Privacy & Security > FileVault to turn this on. This ensures that if your laptop is lost or stolen, your data remains unreadable.

Next, turn on the built-in macOS Firewall. Navigate to System Settings > Network > Firewall. Ensure it is active to block unwanted incoming connections. These two steps are the foundation of basic security for any legal professional.
Always check your firm's internal IT policies before changing security settings. Some firms require specific configurations or managed security software that might conflict with personal settings.
blocks.title: Follow firm policy

blocks.text: Lazur helps you maintain focus and accuracy. By using voice commands, you can quickly double-check file names or verify that you are working in the correct folder without clicking through dozens of subdirectories. It keeps your hands on the keyboard and your eyes on the document.

faq.question: Is it safe to use AI tools for legal work?
faq.answer: Only if the tool guarantees that your data is not used for training and remains private. Always ensure your firm has approved the use of any AI tool for handling client information.

faq.question: What is the biggest risk for paralegals?
faq.answer: Human error, such as sending an email to the wrong recipient or failing to redact sensitive information from a document, is the most common cause of data breaches.
